limitations: Shared native browser process and OS caches.
Native panel status stayed visible=false despite explicit open/show=true; document visibility and recorded events were visible throughout. Do not claim physical foreground.
Unknown legacy/user-owned applications were not closed or exhaustively audited.
Event completion boundary includes unchanged loader RAF-or-1000ms timeout wait; no pixel readback.
